newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Foreign investment in Malaysia tops $8 bln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment in Malaysia tops $8 bln in 1996.

text.p: Foreign investment in Malaysia up to August has surpassed the 20 billion ringgit ($8.0 billion) recorded in all of 1995, the Malaysian Industrial Development Authority (MIDA) said.
Foreign investment approvals at the end of August totalled 21 billion ringgit, MIDA Director General Zainun Aishah Ahmad was quoted as saying by the national Bernama news agency.
Japan and Taiwan remained the top foreign investors in the country. The bulk of investment was in the electronics industry.
